question: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala is currently heading which of the following institutions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**WTO**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala is the current Director-General of the World Trade Organization (WTO).**
 
• She** took office on March 1, 2021, and is the first woman and first African to hold the position.**
 
• Her **first term ends on August 31, 2025. **
 
• Okonjo-Iweala is an economist and international development expert with over 30 years of experience.
 
• She also serves on Twitter's board of directors, chairs the Gavi vaccine alliance, and is a special envoy for the World Health Organization's COVID-19 fight

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The International Monetary Fund (IMF), the World Bank, the World Trade Organization (WTO), and the Asian Development Bank are all organizations that work in different areas of international economic**s: 

 
 
• Focuses on macroeconomic and financial stability to promote economic growth and prevent currency devaluation. 
 
 
 
• **World Bank:** Provides financial assistance to developing nations to reduce poverty and support development.
 
 
• The World Bank was originally established in 1944 as the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) to help rebuild Europe and Japan after World War II. 
 
 
 
• **World Trade Organization (WTO):** Manages the rules of trade between nations by settling agreements to encourage free trade. 
 
• **Asian Development Bank:** Has headquarters in Metro Manila, Philippines, and field offices in Asia and the Pacific.
